Commentary.Commentary: Kohli made his marathon innings look really easy as he hardly ran out of intensity. Umesh and Bhuvi managed to score some quick runs in the end to get the Indian total to 631. The England bowlers were torrid with Rashid and Moeen Ali bowling nearly 60 percent of the overs. Root also chipped in with few and was rewarded with a couple of wickets like Moeen. Rashid managed to get four but he was hammered all round the park to get those. Can the English batsmen come in and survive the scares or will it be the Indian bowlers who come out on top? Join us in a while.

England would have loved to rattle the Indians out then but Jadeja came in and scored a crucial 25. Jayant Yadav alongside Kohli started making the difference between the two teams as they managed to strike a partnership of 241 runs which involved the former scoring his maiden Test Hundred. Kohli played one of his best knocks to reach his career best Test Score of 235. Jayant lost his wicket with a tired looking shot while Kohli lost it trying to cut loose but not after playing a gem.

Indians have ended up their 1st innings on a high, thanks to some incredible batting. Rahul got out really early and then Vijay and Pujara kept on going with a 107 run-stand. Pujara got out just on the second ball of the third day. Kohli came in and started off really well, scoring quickly. Vijay got to his hundred in style and he soon threw his wicket to Rashid. England spinners got some quick and cheap wickets of Nair, Ashwin and Patel.

Welcome folks for the Day 4 of the fourth Test match between India and England. India are already leading by 51 runs and are very well in top gear to get a sizeable lead. India will look to bat as long as possible to reach in a position where they don't have to chase a big total batting last on this wicket. England on the other hand will try and get the hosts out as soon as possible so that they can equal terms and post a good total on board for the Indians.

Welcome back for the final session. VIRAT KOHLI and RAVINDRA JADEJA are out in the middle to bat. Will they continue to attack or will they bide their time to frustrate England? England's tactics could be key to the game from here on. The spinners have bowled a lot already, will they continue or will Cook get his pacers back on? Let's see. England begin with ADIL RASHID! Here we go...
DAY 3... SESSION 3....

Both Kohli and Jadeja played their shots to deflect the pressure back on England. With the pitch breaking up, every run matters and hence the visitors will hope to wrap this up quickly and get batting. India will aim to delay it as much possible and try and sneak in a lead. It promises to be another exciting session. Join us in a while for it.

An eventful session of Test cricket! The honors are probably even one may say with India still trailing by 52 runs. England struck at regular intervals in the session as the spinners finally found their lines and lengths to induce the false strokes. The stand between the Indian skipper who has looked solid and Jadeja though eased the nerves for the Indians, finding the gaps to keep the scoreboard ticking.

Welcome folks to the third day of the fourth Test between India and England. India had a good day yesterday as they bundled out the visitors for 400 and they comfortably saw out the new ball with ease as they only lost a wicket of KL Rahul. Vijay got his fifty and was well supported by Pujara. They will try to carry on from yesterday. England will try to hamper their plans by getting some quick wickets to stop the run of flow and stay on top of the game. Let's see how the day turns out to be.
Day 3, Session 1...

England will be disappointed with the way they have bowled. The pitch has been assisting the spinners but they lacked discipline to sustain any pressure. The hosts still trail by 254 runs and will hope to get as close to England's total as possible. The visitors on the other hand, will want to come back fresh, with new plans and stay in the game with a flurry of wickets. It promises to be an exciting day tomorrow, do join us for all the action on Day 3 at 0930 IST. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Both Pujara and Vijay were superb, especially against the spinners and both used contrasting ways. Vijay was happy to take the attack to the English spinners while Pujara was happy to play the waiting game and build the innings. India will want these two to carry on and put in a huge first innings score on the board since batting will get progressively difficult.

Welcome back for the final session of play! MURALI VIJAY and CHETESHWAR PUJARA are out to bat. Will India continue to take the spinners on or will they look to build taking their time? England begin with JAKE BALL! Here we go...
DAY 2... SESSION 3....

The wicket of Rahul didn't stop Vijay from continuing the attack and had his fair share of luck in the session. The England pacers attacked the Indian batsmen with short ball without much success. Spinner looked good in bits but weren't that threatening. Cheteshwar Pujara has now joined Vijay in the middle and will look to build a big partnership. Let's see how both the teams go about in the final session of the day. Stay tuned!

A session with which the hosts will be the happier side. Soon after the lunch, the Indian spinning duo completed the job by picking the last 2 wickets in a quick succession.
